value.answer: This needs emergency care now - go to the ER or call 911. Any fever like this in a baby under 3 months needs immediate medical checking, even if the baby seems okay otherwise.
value.triage: Do not wait or call 811 for this one - go straight to the ER now. If your baby is very hard to wake, floppy, struggling to breathe, or has a seizure, call 911 immediately.
value.sources: HealthyChildren.org (AAP), Health811 Ontario, CDC pediatric fever guidance
